definition: the big organ that cleans the blood
description: In a bright lecture room during an anatomy class, a young woman medical student with long braids, in a white coat over blue scrubs, sits on a chair and holds a large reddish-brown model of a liver against the upper right side of her body. An older man in a jacket leans in and points at it with a pen, and her smile turns into a pained grimace. Behind them stand a white skeleton model and a half-open torso model showing the organs, next to a blackboard, and other students in white coats sit at desks taking notes.

en.question: What is the woman with braids holding?

de.question: Was hält die Frau mit den Zöpfen?

es.answer: Está agarrando un modelo de hígado.
es.question: ¿Qué está sosteniendo la mujer de las trenzas?

fr.answer: Elle serre une maquette de foie.
